questions.questionText:

the ball.
air resistance
gravitational force

Which statement is correct?

options.text: The acceleration of the ball decreases.

The speed of the ball decreases.
The gravitational force on the ball decreases.

questions.questionText:
A compressed spring projects a ball horizontally in a vacuum chamber.
On the Earth, the ball reaches the chamber floor 4.0m in front of the spring.
An identical experiment is done on the Moon. The gravitational field strength is lower on the
Moon than on the Earth.
The experimental results on the Moon are compared with those on the Earth.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: The horizontal speed is greater on the Moon and the ball hits the floor 4.0m in front of the spring.
The horizontal speed is greater on the Moon and the ball hits the floor more than 4.0m in front of the spring.
The horizontal speed is the same on the Moon and the ball hits the floor 4.0m in front of the spring.
The horizontal speed is the same on the Moon and the ball hits the floor more than 4.0m in front of the spring.

options.text: convection currents in the water

questions.questionText:
Metals are good thermal conductors.
Insulators are poor thermal conductors.
Which description of the mechanism of thermal conductivity is correct?

options.text: In insulators, conduction takes place by electron transfer and molecular vibrations.
In insulators, conduction takes place by electron transfer only.
In metals, conduction takes place by electron transfer and molecular vibrations.
In metals, conduction takes place by electron transfer only.

questions.questionText:
A boy jumps into an indoor swimming pool. He notices that the water appears to get colder as he
goes deeper underwater. This is due to convection.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: Cold water is more dense than warm water so it sinks to the bottom of the pool.
Warm water is more dense than cold water so it rises to the surface of the pool.
The molecules in cold water have more kinetic energy than the molecules in warm water so they move to the bottom of the pool faster.
The molecules in warm water are closer together than the molecules in cold water so they rise to the surface of the pool.
